user.title: Connect Formula Pro Advanced WiFi
user.description: Enter your Baby Brezza cloud account credentials. Your password is used to sign in and is not stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your Baby Brezza session has expired. Sign in with the same account to reconnect your existing machines.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The credentials were rejected. Check your email and password.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Try again and download diagnostics if it persists.

abort.reauth_account_mismatch: Sign in with the same account as this existing integration.

state.bottle_check_needed: Remove and replace bottle to verify it is empty

invalid_auth.message: Your Baby Brezza session is no longer valid. Sign in again.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to reach the Baby Brezza cloud. Check your internet connection and try again.

selection_required.message: Choose a bottle preset before starting.

invalid_preset.message: This preset is no longer available for this machine. Refresh data and select a current preset.

invalid_target.message: Target the machine summary sensor when using Start bottle.

command_failed.message: The cloud rejected the start request. Refresh data and check the machine before trying again.

command_indeterminate.message: The start outcome is uncertain. Check the machine; the request will not be retried automatically. Remove and replace the bottle before another start if requested.

refresh_failed.message: Unable to refresh cloud data. Previously received data is retained; try again later.

blocked_device_unavailable.message: The machine is disconnected or its current state is unavailable. Check the machine and cloud connection, then refresh data before trying again.

blocked_request_pending.message: A start request is already being checked or is waiting for a machine update. Check the machine and wait for that request to resolve before trying again.

blocked_making_bottle.message: The machine is already preparing a bottle. Wait for it to finish, then remove the completed bottle before starting another.

blocked_occupied_bottle.message: Remove the completed bottle and replace it with an empty bottle before starting another preparation.

blocked_bottle_check_needed.message: The integration cannot verify that the bottle is empty. Remove the bottle, check or empty it, and replace it before starting.

blocked_readiness_unverified.message: The cloud has not reported all fields needed to verify that the machine is ready. Refresh data and check the machine. If this continues, download diagnostics for support.

blocked_bottle_missing.message: Place an empty bottle under the funnel, then wait for the machine to report it present before starting.

blocked_funnel_cleaning_needed.message: Clean and reinstall the funnel according to the manufacturer's instructions, then wait for the cleaning alert to clear before starting.

blocked_funnel_out.message: Reinstall the funnel, then wait for the machine to report it present before starting.

blocked_lid_open.message: Close the machine lid, then wait for the lid alert to clear before starting.

blocked_low_water.message: Refill the water tank according to the manufacturer's instructions, then wait for the low-water alert to clear before starting.

blocked_heating.message: The machine is heating. Wait for heating to finish before starting.

blocked_cooling.message: The machine is cooling. Wait for cooling to finish before starting.

turn_on.name: Start bottle
turn_on.description: Start a saved cloud preset after a fresh machine-state safety check. Target the original machine summary sensor.

bottle_id.name: Bottle ID
bottle_id.description: Positive integer ID of a saved preset belonging to the targeted machine.
